plan.notes: Source: SUNY Geneseo 2024-2025 Undergraduate Bulletin (archived catalog), official "Sample Course Map" for Biology, B.S. (the current bulletin is 2025-2026; this is the archived 2024-2025 map, filed honestly as 2024-2025 - disclosed here). Transcribed exactly as published: 15+16+15+17+16+13+14+14 = 120 ("Total Credit Hours: 120"). CREDIT CORRECTION (see WRTG 105 slot note): map prints WRTG 105 at 4 credits, which contradicts its own term total (15) and the 120 total; transcribed at 3 credits per two corroborating official sources, making the map internally consistent. Choice slots transcribed with the bulletin's option lists; credit-difference choices resolved at minimum with disclosure (CHEM 129/209; MATH 222/228/BIOL 350). Multi-credit elective rows transcribed as single slots (5 and 11) to avoid inventing splits - documented in slot notes. Program rules documented in slot notes: minimum C- in BIOL 117/118/119/120/203/222 and the required 200-level lab; three additional biology labs (only one at 200-level); min 18 credits at 300-level+; max 4 credits from BIOL 395-399. Prerequisites recorded only for direct in-plan numbered sequences. Bulletin note: "Variation in the order of courses is possible, depending upon prerequisites. Consult course information in the bulletin or your academic advisor to customize your eight semester plan."

courses.title: Writing Seminar
courses.choice_note: CREDIT CORRECTION (disclosed): the sample map prints "WRTG 105 (4)" but that makes the term sum 16 against the map's own declared 15 credit hours and breaks the 120 total. Two official sources list WRTG 105 Writing Seminar at 3 credits: this bullet's Biology Adolescence Education map (same bulletin, term sums correctly at 15) and SUNY Cortland's Geneseo transfer equivalency table. Transcribed at 3 credits, which makes the map internally consistent (15 / 120).
